itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness as per directions of the Engineer Incharge (i) a- By Manual Means- In area of light jungle
Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu / Jondu from marshy areas as directed with all other ancillary operations complete as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work.

Specification: Providing cleaning Labour for daily activities such as cleaning of debris/floating waste from silt traps, sweeping of pathway, watering of plantation, maintaining of garden/lake, cleaning of toilets if any etc as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of the work. Rate calculated based on Minimum wages and VDA from 01-04-2025 to 31-03-2026. Basic pay as per GO =17,306.52/-,VDA=2,818.80/- ESI(3.25%)=654.07/-, EPF(12%)=1,800/- and Admin charges(0.5%)=75/-, Total amount derived for 26 days=22,654.39/-Per day =Rs. 871.32 (Calculated for 26 days per month; EPF and ESI employer contribution included)

Providing Tractor-trolley for shifting of debris/silt/other materials including crew charges, operational & maintenance charges such as cost of fuel, lubricants etc as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work

Providing Backhoe loader 1m3 capacity for Cleaning purpose including crew charges, operational & maintenance charges such as cost of fuel, lubricants etc as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work

Providing water tankers  (6 KL) for supply of water for plantation and toilets including crew charges, operational & maintenance charges such as cost of fuel, lubricants etc as per the directions of the Engineer in charge of work

Excavation and removal of silt or slush in marshy condition by mechanical means from Silt traps/Inlets/tank bed using shovel 0.85 cum 110hp ,  including stacking the same for drying and loading & unloading of the same using Tipper 10 m3, Excluding cost of haulage, including cost of machinary, labour etc., with initial lead upto 50 m and all lifts complete as per the direction of the engineer in charge of work.
